description: This file contains a class that extends PHPStan to provide static type analysis for specific preg_match methods, focusing on their parameters and return types, especially handling regex match results.

classes.name: PregMatchParameterOutTypeExtension
classes.description: A class that extends PHPStan's static method parameter type extension to provide custom return type inference for preg match methods, based on method parameters and regex patterns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex shape matcher dependency.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given static method is supported based on its declaring class, method name, and the parameter name.

methods.name: getParameterOutTypeFromStaticMethodCall
methods.description: Determines the return type of static preg match methods based on the arguments, supporting both match and matchAll variants.
